"''My—my father used to take me hunting on Vanqor as a child.|Kazuda Xiono and Synara San|audio=MyFatherOnVanqor-TheDozaDilemma.flac|}} A [[Gender|male]] individual was the '''father''' of the [[Mirialan]] [[pirate]] [[Synara San]]. When Synara was questioned by [[Resistance]] [[spy]]{{Resistance|The Recruit}} [[Kazuda Xiono]] about her skills with a [[blaster]], she claimed that her [[Parent|father]] taught her how to shoot while [[hunting]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]]''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' of [[Vanqor]] when she was a [[Youngling|child]]. ==Behind the scenes== Synara San's father was first mentioned in "[[The Doza Dilemma]]," in the fourteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} which aired on [[January 27]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-doza-dilemma-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "The Doza Dilemma" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Père de Synara San }} {{DEFAULTSORT:San, Synara's father}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
